title: The Matrix
tagline: Gruel tonight. Steak in the simulation.
about: A hacker discovers the world is a simulation and joins the fight against the machines.

Red pill: see the real world
Blue pill: back to your desk

No complaints to the cook. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Printed by the ship's system. Form G-101, sheet 2 of 2. 1999. Crew notes: The red pill and the blue pill. Cypher eating steak with Agent Smith. The white rabbit tattoo.

    StartersCypher's steak bitesSeared rump cubes tossed in garlic butter, with a peppercorn sour cream dipHow to make it600g rump steak40g butter2 garlic cloves, crushed150g sour cream1 tsp cracked black peppercornssalt, to tasteCut the rump into cubes and season well.Mix the sour cream with the cracked pepper for the dip.Sear the steak hard in a smoking pan in batches.Toss with the butter and garlic. Serve on toothpicks with the dip.Green code crackersLavash strips baked crisp with green parsley and dill saltHow to make it1 small bunch parsley1 small bunch dill2 tbsp sea salt flakes3 lavash breads2 tbsp vegetable oilHeat the oven to 180°C. Blitz the parsley and dill with the salt until green.Brush the lavash with oil, sprinkle with the herb salt and cut into long thin strips.Bake until crisp.MainsCypher's steakDry-brined sirloin basted in butter and thyme, red wine pan sauceHow to make it4 sirloin steaks1 tsp sea salt flakes70g butter1 bunch thyme125ml red wine250ml beef stockSalt the steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Sear hard in a hot pan.Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then rest the steaks.Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.Slice the steak and pour over the sauce.Neo's street noodlesThe noodle place Neo remembers from the old lifeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Wheat noodles tossed with spicy pork mince, sesame and chilli oil sauce, Sichuan pepper and blanched bok choy, topped with crushed peanuts and spring onion.Fry 400g pork mince in 1 tbsp oil until crisp, then add 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine.Mix 3 tbsp tahini, 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 3 tbsp chilli oil, 1 tsp sugar, 1 crushed garlic clove and half a tsp ground Sichuan pepper.Cook 500g fresh wheat noodles and 4 halved baby bok choy for 2 minutes.Divide the sauce between 4 bowls, add the noodles and bok choy, top with pork, peanuts and spring onion and toss.SweetsThe Oracle's cookiesBrown butter chocolate chip cookies finished with flaky saltHow to make it150g butter200g brown sugar1 egg250g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda200g choc chipspinch of sea salt flakesBrown the butter and cool.Beat with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour, bicarb and choc chips.Rest the dough overnight in the fridge.Roll into 16 balls and bake at 180°C until golden.Sprinkle with flaky salt.DrinksRed pill or blue pill gin fizzTwo gin fizzes: red with raspberry and cranberry, blue with curaçaoHow to make it180ml gin2 lemons30ml raspberry syrup60ml cranberry juice30ml blue curacao15ml sugar syrup350ml soda water1 bag iceFor the red drinks, shake half the gin with half the lemon juice, the raspberry syrup and cranberry juice with ice and strain into two ice-filled glasses.For the blue drinks, shake the rest of the gin and lemon juice with the blue curacao and sugar syrup and strain into two ice-filled glasses.Top all four with soda water and add a lemon wheel.
